test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the correctly spelled word.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4 **i.e. **Domineering'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Domineering **is the correct spelling for a term that describes someone who is asserting one's will over another in an arrogant way (ज़बरदस्ती, अत्यधिक नियंत्रण रखने वाले). 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Option 4: Domineering'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other three options **'Dominering', 'Domoneering', and 'Dominiering' **are incorrect spellings and not recognised as words in the English language
